BREAKING — Carolina Munoz-Perez was arrested early Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, at 2:03 a.m., and booked into the Webb County Jail on two alleged child-endangerment counts, each classified as a state jail felony, according to Webb County booking records.

Munoz-Perez was booked (Booking #202608919) on two counts of ABANDON ENDANGER CHILD W/INTENT RETURN — each a state jail felony under Texas law — filed under Case #PFDC26-002960D1. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record lists her city as Laredo, Texas; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

The abandon/endanger child charge (Texas Penal Code, Section 22.041) relates to allegedly abandoning a child under circumstances that expose the child to an unreasonable risk of harm, with intent to return for the child.

A state jail felony in Texas is punishable by 180 days to two years in a state jail facility and a fine of up to $10,000. Webb Watch 956 will follow Case #PFDC26-002960D1 as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Carolina Munoz-Perez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Booking #202608919, Oct. 21, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal (Case #PFDC26-002960D1).

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
